# Build index by pair and by node
from collections import defaultdict
by_pair=defaultdict(list)
by_node=defaultdict(list)
for u,v,t in ev_window:
    by_pair[(u,v)].append(t)
    by_node[u].append((v,t))
    by_node[v].append((u,t))  # interactions are directed but contact is symmetric for common contact

# Find closing interactions where both endpoints are in nodes list
closings=[]
for u,v,t in ev_window:
    if u in nodes and v in nodes:
        closings.append((u,v,t))
print('closing interactions among target nodes in window:', len(closings))
# For each closing, search for supporting interactions: find c such that both u and v interacted with c at times t1,t2 before t and max(t1,t2)>=t-800
supports=[]
for u,v,t_close in closings:
    for c in set([x for x in range(0,2000)]):
        pass
# Instead iterate over actual nodes seen interacting with u and v in window (common contacts)
for u,v,t_close in closings:
    u_contacts = [(c,tt) for c,tt in by_node[u] if tt < t_close]
    v_contacts = [(c,tt) for c,tt in by_node[v] if tt < t_close]
    common = set([c for c,tt in u_contacts]) & set([c for c,tt in v_contacts])
    for c in common:
        t1 = max([tt for cc,tt in u_contacts if cc==c])
        t2 = max([tt for cc,tt in v_contacts if cc==c])
        if t_close - max(t1,t2) <= 800 and t_close > max(t1,t2):
            supports.append({'closing':(u,v,t_close),'common':c,'t_u_c':t1,'t_v_c':t2,'dt':t_close-max(t1,t2)})

print('found supports:', len(supports))
# Print some
for s in supports[:20]:
    print(s)

# Also check supporting interactions themselves occurred within window
supports_in_window = [s for s in supports if start <= s['t_u_c'] <= end and start <= s['t_v_c'] <= end]
print('supports with both supports in window:', len(supports_in_window))
for s in supports_in_window[:20]:
    print(s)

# Also print nodes involved
involved_nodes = set()
for s in supports_in_window:
    u,v,t = s['closing']
    involved_nodes.update([u,v,s['common']])
print('involved nodes sample:', list(involved_nodes)[:20])

from collections import defaultdict
# build index by node for full log
by_node_full=defaultdict(list)
for u,v,t in events:
    by_node_full[u].append((v,t))
    by_node_full[v].append((u,t))

supports=[]
for u,v,t_close in closings:
    u_contacts = by_node_full[u]
    v_contacts = by_node_full[v]
    # find contacts c with t1,t2 < t_close
    u_by_c = defaultdict(list)
    for c,tt in u_contacts:
        if tt < t_close:
            u_by_c[c].append(tt)
    v_by_c = defaultdict(list)
    for c,tt in v_contacts:
        if tt < t_close:
            v_by_c[c].append(tt)
    common = set(u_by_c.keys()) & set(v_by_c.keys())
    for c in common:
        t1 = max(u_by_c[c])
        t2 = max(v_by_c[c])
        if t_close - max(t1,t2) <= 800 and t_close > max(t1,t2):
            supports.append({'closing':(u,v,t_close),'common':c,'t_u_c':t1,'t_v_c':t2,'dt':t_close-max(t1,t2),'support_in_window': (start<=t1<=end and start<=t2<=end)})

print('supports found:', len(supports))
for s in supports:
